fields.title: TikTok public record
fields.description: One row per scraped entity. The five modes share this envelope, so every field is nullable and only the fields relevant to a row's `_mode` are populated. Read `_mode` first, then `_warning`, which records surface ceilings rather than failures - a hashtag or music page ships a single non-paginable page, and its rows carry `playCount` but no like/comment/share counters. Rows that failed carry `_error` instead of data: every input produces at least one row.

_mode.title: Mode
_mode.description: Which surface produced this row: video, profile, hashtag, music or oembed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The target this row belongs to, as resolved from your input entry. For a short link resolved to a canonical url, this keeps the short link you supplied.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: embed-frontity-state when the row was parsed out of an embed page's server-rendered state, oembed-api when it came from TikTok's oEmbed endpoint, or none on a failure row.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp of the scrape.

_index.title: Index
_index.description: Position of this video within a hashtag or music page listing, starting at 1. Null for the single-row modes.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal ceiling affecting this row. Values: single_page_surface_embed_playlist_is_not_paginable (the hashtag/music embed ships one page and its loader API is signature-gated), playlist_rows_carry_play_count_only_no_digg_or_comment_counts, profile_embed_does_not_publish_a_video_list, play_count_rounded_by_tiktok (TikTok serves 11000, not 11043). Multiple values are joined with a semicolon.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: INVALID_INPUT (the entry could not be parsed for this mode), NOT_FOUND (the username, video, hashtag or sound does not resolve publicly), PRIVATE_ACCOUNT, EMPTY_RESULT (the entity exists but its embed shipped no videos), BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES (every retry and TLS profile was exhausted - add or rotate a proxy), UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED (TikTok moved the payload; the parser needs updating).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Human-readable explanation of `_error`, including the HTTP status or payload keys observed.

videoId.title: Video id
videoId.description: TikTok's numeric video id, as a string to survive JSON number precision.

videoUrl.title: Video URL
videoUrl.description: Canonical watch url, rebuilt from the author handle and video id.

description.title: Description
description.description: The video caption, including its inline hashtags as the author typed them.

createTime.title: Created (unix)
createTime.description: Upload time as a unix timestamp. Video mode only.

createTimeIso.title: Created (ISO)
createTimeIso.description: Upload time as a UTC ISO 8601 string. Video mode only.

playCount.title: Views
playCount.description: Play count as TikTok publishes it - rounded at scale (11000 rather than 11043). The only counter available in hashtag and music rows.

commentCount.title: Comments
commentCount.description: Comment count. The comments themselves are not available: TikTok's comment API is signature-gated. Video mode only.

videoDuration.title: Duration
videoDuration.description: Duration in seconds. TikTok serves the placeholder 99 on some videos; reported as served rather than corrected.

videoRatio.title: Ratio
videoRatio.description: Quality label such as 720p. Hashtag and music rows.

coverUrl.title: Cover URL
coverUrl.description: Static thumbnail on TikTok's CDN. The url carries a signed expiry.

originCoverUrl.title: Original cover URL
originCoverUrl.description: Uncropped thumbnail. Hashtag and music rows.

playAddr.title: Play address
playAddr.description: Direct media url as served to the embed player. Signed and short-lived. Hashtag and music rows.

isPhotoPost.title: Photo post
isPhotoPost.description: True when the post is an image carousel rather than a video.

isPrivateItem.title: Private item
isPrivateItem.description: True when the listing marks the video private. Hashtag and music rows.

isAd.title: Is ad
isAd.description: True when TikTok flags the video as an ad.

isOriginal.title: Original sound
isOriginal.description: True when the video uses the author's original audio.

isEcommerceVideo.title: Shop video
isEcommerceVideo.description: True when the video is tagged as TikTok Shop content.

brandOrganicType.title: Branded content type
brandOrganicType.description: TikTok's branded-content disclosure type, empty on ordinary posts.

locationCreated.title: Country created
locationCreated.description: Two-letter country code TikTok attributes the upload to.

hashtags.title: Hashtags
hashtags.description: Hashtag names attached to the video as structured challenges. Often empty even when the caption contains tags, because TikTok only links some of them.

userId.title: User id
userId.description: Numeric account id as a string. Profile mode.

privateAccount.title: Private account
privateAccount.description: True for a private account; the row also carries _error=PRIVATE_ACCOUNT. Profile mode.

followerCount.title: Followers
followerCount.description: Follower count, rounded by TikTok at scale. Profile mode.

followingCount.title: Following
followingCount.description: Accounts this account follows. Profile mode.

heartCount.title: Total likes
heartCount.description: Lifetime likes across the account's videos. Profile mode.

avatarUrl.title: Avatar URL
avatarUrl.description: Profile picture on TikTok's CDN. Profile mode.

authorSecUid.title: Author secUid
authorSecUid.description: Uploader's opaque secondary id, the key TikTok's own APIs use for an account.

authorFollowerCount.title: Author followers
authorFollowerCount.description: Uploader's follower count, delivered alongside the video - so one video request also yields the account's audience size.

authorVideoCount.title: Author video count
authorVideoCount.description: How many videos the uploader has posted.

musicId.title: Sound id
musicId.description: Numeric sound id as a string. Feed it back in through music mode to see other videos using it.

musicAuthorName.title: Sound artist
musicAuthorName.description: Artist credited for the sound. Video mode.

musicPlayUrl.title: Sound URL
musicPlayUrl.description: Direct audio url, signed and short-lived. Video mode.

playlistType.title: Listing type
playlistType.description: hashtag or music, as TikTok labels the embed playlist.

entityId.title: Listing entity id
entityId.description: Id of the hashtag or sound the listing belongs to.

musicArtist.title: Listing artist
musicArtist.description: Artist of the sound behind a music listing.

entityVideoCount.title: Listing total videos
entityVideoCount.description: How many videos TikTok says use this sound or tag in total - far more than the page ships, and the reason the single-page ceiling is worth knowing.

entityCoverUrl.title: Listing cover URL
entityCoverUrl.description: Cover image of the sound or tag.

title.title: oEmbed title
title.description: Video caption as TikTok's oEmbed endpoint reports it. oembed mode.

embedType.title: Embed type
embedType.description: oEmbed product type, e.g. video. oembed mode.
